title: Disposition of collected fines and penalties.
bodyText: Fines and penalties collected under sections 342F-9 and 342F-11 shall be deposited into the environmental response revolving fund established by section 128D-2.
bodyHtml: [§342F-11.5]  Disposition of collected fines and penalties.  Fines and penalties collected under sections 342F-9 and 342F-11 shall be deposited into the environmental response revolving fund established by section 128D-2. [L 1991, c 157, §3]
